rows.about: | `direction` | string or null            | The direction of the header as writt

judgment.note:
In timeline/header-direction-line-feed (`timeline
TD
  a
`), removing the first TimelinePeriodStatement at [9,11] from TimelineDiagram.body, retyping its RawText token at [9,11] to Keyword, and changing direction from null to "TD" gives checkTree() = []. It treats the period on the next line as the header direction. In timeline/header-direction-line-separator (`timeline TD
`), the same three changes give checkTree() = [] and treat a period after U+2028 as the direction, although only spaces or tabs may separate it from the header. Both the field meaning and the header-line/space-or-tab condition are missed. The other cases are reported: an invalid direction (check-tree-timeline.test.ts, "a direction that is none of the directions"), changed written case (check-tree-shared-ast.test.ts, "fails a timeline direction whose written case is changed"), an omitted written direction ("fails a timeline direction that leaves out its written keyword"), and a direction where none is written (check-tree-timeline.test.ts, "a direction where the header has none"). The child field and the absence of a header field are checked by check-tree-shared-ast.test.ts, "reports a child field whose value is a primitive instead of a child node", and check-tree-shape.test.ts, "reports a field that the type does not have".
